metric_definitions.defect_recall: matched defect events / total truth defect events
metric_definitions.underkill: unmatched truth events / total truth events
metric_definitions.false_positive_rate: positive normal inspection units / total normal units
metric_definitions.precision: matched defect events / (matched events + false-alarm events)
metric_definitions.unknown_defect_recall: matched unknown events / truth unknown events
metric_definitions.false_alarms_per_100m: false alarm events *100 / calibrated non-overlapping inspected meters
metric_definitions.missed_defects_per_100m: unmatched truth events *100 / calibrated non-overlapping inspected meters
metric_definitions.p50_latency_ms: numpy linear percentile50 of full-hybrid finite synchronized warmup-excluded samples
metric_definitions.p95_latency_ms: numpy linear percentile95, same required full-hybrid scope
metric_definitions.throughput_images_per_second: explicit measured throughput images / wall seconds; protocol declared
metric_definitions.per_class_recall: one-to-one known event matches / truth events for each candidate foreground class; missing coverage blocks
